```{r}
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)
# Step 1: Read the file with no name mangling
annotated_data <- read.csv("expression_with_annotations.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Step 2: Fix column names to match pbmc
colnames(annotated_data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(annotated_data))

# Step 3: Extract the last row (cell types)
cell_types <- as.character(annotated_data[nrow(annotated_data), ])
names(cell_types) <- colnames(annotated_data)

# Step 4: Match to pbmc column order
cell_types <- cell_types[colnames(pbmc)]

# Step 5: Add to metadata and assign identities
cell_types_df <- data.frame(celltype = cell_types, row.names = colnames(pbmc))
pbmc <- AddMetaData(pbmc, metadata = cell_types_df)
Idents(pbmc) <- "celltype"
```

generate csv files
```{r}
expr_matrix <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(pbmc, assay = "RNA", slot = "data"))
# 2. Extract cell annotations
cell_annotations <- as.character(Idents(pbmc))  # or pbmc$cell_type if you've renamed it

# 3. Add annotation as a new row to the matrix
# Must ensure matching column names
names(cell_annotations) <- colnames(expr_matrix)

# 4. Bind the annotation as a new row (requires character conversion)
expr_with_annotation <- rbind(expr_matrix, cell_type = cell_annotations)

# 5. Save to CSV
write.csv(expr_with_annotation, file = "expression_with_annotations_normalized.csv")
```
```{r}
# display number of cells in each cluster

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
cluster_counts <- table(pbmc$seurat_clusters)
cluster_df <- as.data.frame(cluster_counts)
colnames(cluster_df) <- c("Cluster", "Cell_Count")
# Add cell type info from Idents into the metadata
pbmc$cell_type <- Idents(pbmc)

head(pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
# Count number of cells per cluster and cell type
cluster_type_counts <- pbmc@meta.data %>%
  count(seurat_clusters, cell_type) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
    Cluster = seurat_clusters,
    CellType = cell_type,
    Count = n
  )
 

# Bar plot: stacked bar chart of cell type composition per cluster
ggplot(cluster_type_counts, aes(x = as.factor(Cluster), y = Count, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Cell Type Composition per Cluster",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

cluster_type_counts
```

Find Markers
```{r}
library(Seurat)
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  pbmc,
  assay = "RNA",          # Use the SCT assay
  slot = "data",          # Use normalized data (log-transformed corrected counts)
  test.use = "wilcox",    # Wilcoxon rank-sum test
  only.pos = TRUE,        # Only return positive markers
  min.pct = 0.25,        # Gene must be detected in at least 25% of cells in either cluster
  logfc.threshold = 0.25, # Minimum log2 fold change
  verbose = FALSE
)
```
HEATMAP
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Select top 10 markers per cluster based on avg_log2FC
top_markers <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 10)

# Draw heatmap with those genes
DoHeatmap(
  object = pbmc,
  features = unique(top_markers$gene),
  group.by = "seurat_clusters"
) +
  ggtitle("Top 10 Marker Genes per Cluster")
```

Cluster Markers
```{r, echo=FALSE}

cluster_markers <- FindMarkers(
  object = pbmc,
  ident.1 = "Naive CD4 T",            # Cluster 0
  ident.2 = "Memory CD4 T",            # Cluster 1
  assay = "RNA",            # Or "SCT" if SCTransform was used
  slot = "data",            # Use normalized data
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(ggrepel)
 
# Add gene names and significance status
cluster_markers$gene <- rownames(cluster_markers)
cluster_markers$significance <- "Not Significant"

# Define thresholds
logfc_cutoff <- 0.25
pval_cutoff <- 0.05

cluster_markers$significance[cluster_markers$avg_log2FC > logfc_cutoff & cluster_markers$p_val_adj < pval_cutoff] <- "Up in NAIVE CD4 T"
cluster_markers$significance[cluster_markers$avg_log2FC < -logfc_cutoff & cluster_markers$p_val_adj < pval_cutoff] <- "Up in Memory CD4 T"

# Subset genes to label (adjust n as needed)
top_genes_to_label <- cluster_markers %>%
  filter(significance != "Not Significant") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Volcano plot with labels
ggplot(cluster_markers, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in NAIVE CD4 T" = "red", "Up in Memory CD4 T" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "gray")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes_to_label,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 50
  ) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster NAIVE CD4 T vs Memory CD4 T",
       x = "Average Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted p-value",
       color = "Expression") +
  theme_minimal()

```
HEATMAP
```{r}
# Step 1: Subset top genes from your DE result
top_genes <- cluster_markers %>%
  filter(significance != "Not Significant") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Step 2: Subset only the two clusters (e.g., 0 and 2)
pbmc_subset <- subset(pbmc, idents = c('Naive CD4 T', 'Memory CD4 T'))

# Step 3: Create heatmap
DoHeatmap(
  pbmc_subset,
  features = top_genes,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters"
) +
  ggtitle("Heatmap of Top Markers: NAIVE CD4 T vs Memory CD4 T")

```
